positive.prompt: Support keeps getting asked for a way to get reports out of the product. Can you turn that into an idea?
I have a rough idea: let admins export audit logs. Write it up as an idea brief for triage.
Draft a G0 brief for this problem: customers cannot tell why their import failed.

negative.prompt: Write the PRD for the invoice export
Stress-test the assumptions behind this product idea and widen the options before we commit

evals.prompt: Sales sent this ticket. Turn it into an idea brief.
evals.expected_output: A short list of questions before any drafting, then a half-page brief that does not design a solution
expectations: Notices the ticket is a solution with no stated problem and asks who has the problem and what it costs them
Asks no more than three short questions before drafting
Does not guess evidence, size or data class; marks them as unknown or asks
The brief stays about half a page and proposes no design
Does not file an issue without the user confirming the command

evals.prompt: Here are my answers: finance leads ask for it weekly, it costs support two days per request, data is customer invoices. Finish the brief and file it.
evals.expected_output: A completed brief and an offer to file it with the stage:idea label, pending confirmation
expectations: Fills every template section using the answers given
States the data class as Confidential or flags it for confirmation, not as Public
Offers gh issue create with the stage:idea label and waits for confirmation before running it
